source: eth_call against the deployed RWA contracts on X Layer mainnet

rules.name: Price must track its reference
rules.plain: If the market price drifts further than this from the reference price, the agent stops trading it.

rules.name: The price must be recent
rules.plain: A price older than this is refused. Stale data on a real-world asset is how an agent trades yesterday's market.

rules.name: No trading near a redemption window
rules.plain: Real-world assets have windows where they can be redeemed. Trading close to one is refused, because the price moves for reasons the agent cannot see.

rules.name: The issuer must not be paused
rules.plain: If whoever issues the asset halts it, the agent stops too, rather than trading something nobody is standing behind.
